messages:
andrea: quick q for infra/obs folks — I'm assembling an ops note for the inference SLA. Where are the canonical places to view p50/p95/p99, TTFT, and tokens/sec for the hosted runtime? Also need a couple of trace and logs links to paste. thanks

kai: primary place is Grafana -> Inference / Latency Overview (internal). panels for p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec. TTFT lives under the "Response Path" row. :point_up:

sam: adding direct examples: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/inference-latency?orgId=1&panelId=12 (p95) and https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/inference-latency?orgId=1&panelId=14 (p99) 

maria: PromQL snippets you can copy into the runbook or the Grafana query box:
```
# p95 request latency across inference instances (5m window)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"inference.*"}[5m])) by (le, instance))

# tokens/sec by model (1m window)
sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total{job="inference"}[1m])) by (model)
```

kai: TTFT specifically uses ttft_request_seconds metric (measured at ingress -> first token). quick TTFT query:
```
# p50 TTFT (5m)
histogram_quantile(0.50, sum(rate(ttft_request_seconds_bucket{env="prod"}[5m])) by (le))
```

obs-bot: Traces: jaeger service search -> service=inference-runtime. Example entry point: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/search?service=inference-runtime&limit=20 . Look for spans named "generate" or "send_token" for token path details.

andrea: good — what about logs for cold-start vs slow token churn? want a log query example

sam: Kibana quick filters: `service: "inference-runtime" AND env: "prod"` then add either `cold_start:true` or `message.keyword: "kv-cache miss"` for cache-related slowdowns. Example Lucene: `service:inference-runtime AND cold_start:true AND @timestamp:[now-1h TO now]`

maria: alert tuning notes: current p95 alert (300ms) is noisy during nightly heavy batches. suggestions:
- relax p95 threshold to 500ms for 00:00-06:00 maintenance window
- add p99>1s as a high-severity alert (use SUM of instances)
- add a rate-based alert: increase_in_p95 = increase(histogram_quantile(0.95, ...)[15m]) > 0.3 * baseline -> useful for regressions

kai: also add a tokens/sec health alert, e.g. sustained drop in tokens/sec by region:
```
# burn-in style: sustained <50 tokens/sec per region over 5m
sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total[5m])) by (region) < 50
```

andrea: perfect. I'll draft the ops note and include these queries + links. @sam can you add the grafana/jaeger links to the runbook? :thumbsup:

sam: on it — pushed a small update to the runbook and created PR #452 with the panels and queries. will add a sample Jaeger span next.

maria: lgtm, please also include a small troubleshooting checklist: 1) check KV cache hit rate 2) check GPU queue depth 3) trace slow span 4) correlate with bursts in tokens/sec.

andrea: will do. thanks everyone :pray:
